UKAS
THATTA CEMENT
043-A
COMPANYLIMITED
July 4, 2019
The General Manager
Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited
Stock Exchange Building
Stock Exchange Road
Karachi
Dear Sir,
Subject:
Material Information-Provisional Attachment ofShares
In accordance with section 96 of the Securities Act, 2015 and clause 5.6.1(a) of PSX Regulations, we hereby convey the
following information:
We have been copied to, in Orders issued by Initiating Officer/Deputy Commissioner, Revenue Division, Federal Board of
Revenue, (Benami Zone-ill) to M/s Al-Miftah Holding (Pvt) Limited and M/s Rising Star Holding (Pvt) Limited informing
them that the Initiating Officer / Deputy Commissioner has provisionally attached, for the period of 90 days, the
shareholding of M/s Al-Miftah Holding (Pvt) Limited and M/s Rising Star Holding (Pvt) Limited in Thatta Cement Company
Limited.
The orders referred above have also been copied to the Principal Officer of Pakistan Stock Exchange.
Disclosure form is attached herewith.
Yours Sincerely,
Muhammad Abid Khan
Company Secretary
Copy to: The Director, Surveillance, Supervision & Enforcement Department
Securities & Commission of Pakistan,
NiC Building, 63, Jinnah Avenue, Blue Area, Islamabad
